title: Why did US and Israel attack Iran and how long could the war last?
summary: The death toll in Iran since the US-Israeli attacks began has reached 787, according to the Iranian Red Crescent. The death of Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was killed during the first wave of strikes. The fighting has escalated quickly, pulling in Cyprus and Lebanon in recent days.
originalContent: Why did US and Israel attack Iran and how long could the war last?3 hours agoShareSaveEmily AtkinsonandRaffi Berg,Middle East digital editorShareSaveEPAConflict across the Middle East has entered a fifth day after US and Israeli strikes on Iran, in which the country's supreme leader was killed. Iran has continued to respond by launching attacks on Israel and US-allied states in the Gulf, which have extended to non-military targets, including civilian sites and energy facilities.The fighting has escalated quickly, pulling in Cyprus and Lebanon in recent days, with casualties and damage mounting on all sides.Follow live updatesWhat has been happening in Iran? The US and Israel launched widespread strikes on 28 February, targeting Iran's missile infrastructure, military sites and leadership in the capital, Tehran, and across the country.Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, who led the country since 1989, was killed during the first wave of strikes. Israel's military said dozens more senior figures in the powerful Islamic Revolution Guard Corps (IRGC) were also killed.Since the weekend, the US and Israel have continued to target key sites. Israel said that included a covert nuclear compound. Iran has repeatedly insisted its nuclear programme is entirely peaceful.The death toll in Iran since the US-Israeli attacks began has reached 787, according to the Iranian Red Crescent. Meanwhile, US-based Human Rights Activists in Iran (HRANA) reports that 1,097 civilians have died, including 181 children.Iran accused the US and Israel of launching an attack on a girls' school near an IRGC base in southern Iran on Saturday, saying more than 160 people were killed. The US said it was looking into reports of the incident, while Israel said it was "not aware" of any military operations in the area.Internet connectivity in Iran has been almost entirely restricted and its airspace has been closed.Fears over food shortages in Tehran as residents worry about length of warWatch: Footage from across Iran shows scale of strikesIn maps: Five days of strikes across the Middle EastHow has Iran responded?Iran has described the US and Israeli strikes as "unprovoked, illegal and illegitimate", and has carried out widespread missile and drone attacks in response.The IRGC said it had targeted Israeli government and military sites in Tel Aviv and elsewhere.Strikes have also been reported in countries hosting US bases - Qatar, Bahrain, Jordan, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Kuwait - and US-allied Oman and Saudi Arabia.Drones hit the US embassy in Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh, and a drone also hit a car park adjacent to the US consulate in Dubai.Iran has been accused of widening its attacks to include other targets in recent days, on shipping and civilian sites - including hotels in Dubai.'All red lines have been crossed': Gulf states weigh response to Iranian strikesThe US and its Arab allies issued a joint statement condemning Iran's attacks, saying "the targeting of civilians and of countries not engaged in hostilities is reckless and destabilising behaviour".Elsewhere, a British military base in Cyprus was struck by a drone, according to the UK Ministry of Defence, which the Cypriot president blamed on Iran.Six US servicemen have been killed and 18 injured in action as of Monday, according to Centcom.Why have the US and Israel attacked Iran? Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz described the attacks on Saturday as a "pre-emptive strike" to "remove threats against the state of Israel", although he did not explain why there was a need to take military action at this time.US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Monday the US knew there was going to be Israeli action, which meant America had to act "pre-emptively" in the face of expected Iranian attacks on American forces.Israel Defense Forces (IDF) spokesman Brig Gen Effie Defrin revealed that the military operation was preceded by months of strategic deception that caught Iran off guard.In the US, some lawmakers have called for President Donald Trump's administration to provide evidence that Iran posed a threat before Washington went to war.But there are also underlying reasons.Israel and the US - its closest ally - have been arch-foes of Iran since the Islamic revolution in 1979. The Iranian leadership has consistently called for Israel's elimination and denounced the US as its greatest enemy.The two countries have led Western opposition to Iran's nuclear programme, claiming Iran is seeking to develop a nuclear bomb - something Iran has vehemently denied.They attacked Iranian nuclear and military sites in June 2025 in a war which lasted for 12 days. title: Who will be Iran's next supreme leader?
summary: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei's state funeral postponed as questions loom over who will take up the post. Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz says any successor to Khamenei will be target of elimination. BBC's Lyse Doucet explores who the next leader could be.
originalContent: Who will be Iran's next supreme leader?A state funeral for Iran's former supreme leader, set to begin on Wednesday, has been postponed as questions loom over who may take up the post next.Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed during the first wave of US-Israel attacks on the country on Saturday.Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz has since said that any successor that continues "the plan to destroy Israel, to threaten the United States" and "suppress the Iranian people" will be an "an unequivocal target for elimination".The BBC's chief international correspondent Lyse Doucet explores who that next leader may be - and how the ongoing attacks could impact this process. (Dok warga ) MEDAN, KOMPAS.com - Kejaksaan Negeri Binjai akhirnya menahan Ralasen Ginting, mantan Kepala Dinas Ketahanan Pangan dan Pertanian Kota Binjai yang ditetapkan menjadi tersangka korupsi. Kepala Seksi Intelijen Kejari Binjai, Ronald Reagen Siagian menyampaikan, sebelumnya Ralasen tak bisa ditahan karena menjalani perawatan intensif di Rumah Sakit Bundar Thamrin, Jalan Sei Batang Hari, Kota Medan. "Dia kemarin ngeluh ada gangguan jantung," kata Ronald, Rabu (4/2/2026). Ronald menyampaikan, tim penyidik bersama dokter di RS Djoelham sudah melakukan pemeriksaan kesehatan sebelum Ralasen ditahan. Baca juga: Eks Wakil Ketua DPRD Jember dan 4 Terdakwa Jalani Sidang Perdana Kasus Korupsi Sosperda "Hasilnya, kondisi yang bersangkutan dalam keadaan sehat jasmani dan rohani," sebut Ronald. Oleh karena itu, Ralasen telah resmi ditahan atas surat perintah penahanan nomor: Prin-492/L.2.11./Fd.2/03/2026. Kasus Korupsi Pekerjaan Fiktif Sebelumnya Kepala Kejaksaan Negeri Binjai, Iwan Setiawan mengatakan, Ralasen terjaring kasus pembuatan kontrak atas pekerjaan fiktif pada Dinas Ketahanan Pangan dan Pertanian Kota Binjai Tahun 2022-2025. "Modus tersangka, menawarkan dan membagi kegiatan pekerjaan dengan mekanisme pengadaan langsung kepada kontraktor," kata Iwan saat menggelar konferensi pers di Kantor Kejari Binjai pada Rabu (18/2/2026). Baca juga: Kasus Korupsi PLTA Musi, Kejati Bengkulu Tetapkan Dua Pejabat PLN Sumbagsel Jadi Tersangka "Dia meminta uang tanda jadi atau biaya pembuatan kontrak meskipun kegiatan pekerjaan itu tidak ada di Dokumen Pelaksanaan Anggaran (DPA) maupun perubahannya," tambahnya. Ia menyampaikan, Ralase membagi pekerjaan fiktif itu kepada 10 kontraktor dalam rentang waktu tahun 2024-2025. Para kontraktor memberikan uang tanda jadi itu kepada tersangka atau orang kepercayaannya inisial SH, AR, dan DA. title: Pedri hailed as 'best in the world' by Atletico Madrid rival as Barcelona fall short of Copa del Rey comeback | Goal.com
summary: Atletico Madrid captain pays tribute to Barcelona ace Pedri in Copa semi-final win. Atleti captain Koke hails 21-year-old as one of the best players in the world. Barcelona defeated Atleta 4-3 on aggregate in second leg of Copa del Rey.
originalContent: AFPAdhe MakayasaMar 04, 2026 15:24+07:00Despite Barcelona’s dramatic Copa del Rey exit, Pedri’s masterclass at the Spotify Camp Nou made a lasting impression on his rivals. Atletico Madrid captain Koke paid a glowing tribute to the 21-year-old maestro, hailing him as one of the best players in the world and the definitive "present and future" of Spanish football.Atleti captain pays tribute to Pedri magicIn the aftermath of the bruising encounter, Atletico Madrid captain Koke was quick to single out Barcelona ace Pedri for a performance that defied the final 4-3 aggregate scoreline in the Copa semi-final. The veteran midfielder was left in awe of the 21-year-old’s influence in the second leg, which Barca won 3-0, suggesting that the Spain international is currently operating at a level above almost anyone else in the global game. Koke told reporters: "Barca is a fantastic team. The young lads are flying. Pedri, if he's not the best in the world, is certainly one of the best. It's not easy coming to play at the Camp Nou. With all the atmosphere that's been created... that makes a difference. In the first half especially, we were able to put the game away. It's the defeat that has brought me the most joy. Pedri is a machine. We're so lucky he's Spanish... he's the present and future of Spain. He'll bring a lot of joy to Barça and the national team. Besides being a great footballer, he's a spectacular guy."AFPFlick’s youngsters ignite Camp Nou beliefMarc Bernal, Barcelona's newest academy gem, led the comeback attempt by capitalising on intense early pressure to lift the home fans. Lamine Yamal was the architect in the 29th minute, dribbling down the left flank before delivering a precise cross for Bernal to slot home. The momentum shifted further when Pedri was fouled in the penalty area just before half-time, allowing Raphinha to calmly convert the penalty. Flick's side continued to press in the second half, with Bernal adding a third in the 72nd minute from Joao Cancelo's cross. But despite late chances for Gerard Martin and the introduction of Marcus Rashford, a fourth goal remained elusive.Simeone survives a night of sufferingFor Diego Simeone, the match was a masterclass in survival as Atletico Madrid withstood 21 shots and constant waves of Barcelona attacks to defend their dwindling first-leg advantage. Antoine Griezmann had struck the woodwork earlier in the game, providing a brief respite for the visitors, but for much of the night, Atleti were pinned back in their own defensive third. Koke admitted that his side were fully aware of the challenge they faced in Catalonia, acknowledging that they were made to work for every second of their progression. "We knew we were going to suffer. We had chances in the first half to kill the game, but then they score the second and you have to suffer and resist. The team did what it had to do to get through the tie," the Atleti boss explained.ENJOYED THIS STORY?Add GOAL.com as a preferred source on Google to see more of our reportingGetty Images SportThe end of the road for the holdersThe result sees Barcelona relinquish their crown as Copa del Rey holders, a competition they have famously dominated with 32 titles throughout their history. While the exit hurts, the performance offered plenty of encouragement for Flick as he navigates his second season in the dugout. The Blaugrana dominated possession and tempo, but the mountain left by the 4-0 defeat in the first leg simply proved too steep to climb. Atletico, meanwhile, move on to face either Real Sociedad or Athletic Club in the final, as they look to end their trophy drought and secure their first major piece of silverware in over four years.

title: Iran conflict and China: How it is unsettling Beijing and its ambitions
summary: The Iran war is unsettling China and its ambitions. 'What is the game plan?': The Iran conflict is unsettling the world's second-largest economy. The longer the war drags on, the more it could hurt, especially if traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked.
originalContent: 'What is the game plan?': The Iran war is unsettling China and its ambitions 13 hours agoShareSaveLaura BickerChina correspondentShareSaveAFP via Getty ImagesChina is not feeling the shock of war in the Middle East - yet.But it is feeling the ripples.In the short-term, it has enough oil supplies for several months, after which it could turn to neighbour Russia for help.But China will be calculating what this could mean long-term - not just for its investments in the Middle East, but also for its ambitions.This week, thousands of Communist Party delegates are meeting in Beijing to discuss a roadmap for the world's second-largest economy as it continues to battle low consumption, a prolonged property crisis and huge local debt. On Thursday, China lowered its annual economic growth target to the lowest level since 1991, even as Beijing continues its rapid development of high-tech and renewables industries.China may have hoped to export its way out of economic trouble. But it has spent a year fighting a trade war with the United States, and now faces the prospect of upheaval in the Middle East, which supplies both its major shipping routes and a lot of its energy needs.The longer the war drags on, the more it could hurt, especially if traffic through the Strait of Hormuz remains blocked."A prolonged period of turmoil and insecurity in the Middle East will disrupt other regions of importance for China," says Philip Shetler-Jones from the Royal United Services Institute."African economies, for instance, have been the beneficiary of substantial and steady flows of Gulf capital. If the investment tide goes out, this risks wider instability that undermines the sustainability of China's broader and longer-term interests."That is, given China's global footprint, its investments and markets beyond the Middle East are also vulnerable to a protracted war. And like so many other countries, China too is wary of this fresh bout of unpredictability. "I think China is thinking the same as everyone else," says Professor Kerry Brown, director of the China Lau Institute at King's College London."What is the game plan? Surely the Americans didn't go into this with no game plan."But then, he adds: "Probably, along with everyone else, they would also be thinking, oh God, they really have gone into this with no plan at all. Right, we don't want to get dragged into this like we don't want to get dragged into anything else, but we also need to do something."Not-so-firm friends Iran was always designated as an "ally" of China by many in the West.They have certainly been very friendly. The last foreign trip taken by Tehran's Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei was to Beijing in 1989. He had his photograph taken by the Great Wall.Getty ImagesAli Khamenei with China's then-president Yang Shangkun in May 1989The partnership between them deepened when Xi Jinping visited Tehran in 2016 and the two countries eventually signed a 25-year strategic partnership in 2021. China promised to invest $400bn (£300bn) in Iran over 25 years and, in exchange, Iran would keep the oil flowing. However, analysts believe only a fraction of that money has reached the Iranians. But the oil kept flowing.China imported 1.38 million barrels of crude per day from Iran in 2025, according to the Center on Global Energy Policy - around 12% of China's total crude oil imports. Many of these barrels are alleged to have been relabelled as Malaysian to disguise their origin.The research centre at Columbia University released a report claiming there are more than 46 million barrels of Iranian oil in floating storage in Asia, and even more in bonded storage, which is yet to be cleared by customs, in the Chinese ports of Dalian and Zhoushan, where the National Iranian Oil Company leases tanks.There have also been allegations of arms sales between the two countries. China has denied selling Tehran anti-ship cruise missiles, but US intelligence has accused Beijing of supporting Iran's ballistic missile programme by training engineers and supplying components. Rights groups have alleged that Iran's brutal crackdowns against protesters and critics of the regime has been fuelled by Chinese facial recognition and surveillance tech, shared by Beijing. It may sound like the two were firm friends. All of this even prompted tabloid headlines lumping China and Iran together as an "axis of upheaval" alongside North Korea and Russia. All four do want to challenge the US-led world order, but in truth their relationship was transactional."There's no real ideological or cultural reason why China would get on with Iran," Prof Brown says."China's almost 'divide and rule' strategy was sometimes well-served by Iran being a constant irritant to the US. So I think there are largely negative reasons for China wanting a relationship with Iran, rather than positive reasons."That's a really fragile basis for a relationship, and it worked - up to a point. summary: US president has not addressed Iran since an event earlier today in which he briefly told the assembled crowd that the US is doing "phenomenally" in the military campaign. He added that Iran's navy and communications are "gone", along with their Air Force and two tiers of leadership.
originalContent: Bernd Debusmann JrTraveling with the president I'm now in the Miami suburb of Doral, where President Trump is spending the night after arriving from Washington.Trump did not come speak to us at all during the over two-hour flight from Washington DC. He has not addressed Iran since an event earlier today, in which he briefly told the assembled crowd that the US is doing "phenomenally" in the military campaign. He added that Iran's navy and communications are "gone", along with their Air Force and two tiers of leadership. Tomorrow promises to be a busy one for the US president. He is expected to meet with several Latin American leaders at the "Shield of the Americas" summit in Miami before heading to Dover, Delaware.There, he will participate in what is known as a "dignified transfer" ceremony, in which the remains of the six American soldiers killed in an Iranian strike on a base in Kuwait are returned to the US. The Israeli military says it has detected incoming missiles launched from Iran."Defensive systems are operating to intercept the threat," a statement says.An alert is being sent to mobile phones and those receiving it are advised to enter a protected space. Lyse DoucetChief international correspondent Image source, EPAThe US president who likes to keep the world guessing about his endgame in Iran is now telling the world what he wants.In a war widely described as his "war of choice", Donald Trump says he also wants to choose who will rule Iran now that its Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, and dozens of others clerics and commanders, have been assassinated.That seems unthinkable for a clerical regime rooted in deep distrust of America - among its most ideological elements there is burning hostility towards the country they labelled long ago as the "great Satan".Whether Iran's embattled leadership would be mindful of choosing a top cleric willing to work in a different way with Washington is not clear.There has long been division between factions known as reformers and pragmatists, and the hardliners who call themselves Principlists in their defence of their revolution.But they are united on one goal: the survival of the system which keeps them in power.There are reports that the Assembly of Experts - a grouping of some 88 senior clerics tasked with this responsibility - could chose a council of leaders rather than one person to preside in this perilous time.However, it is not even clear that the successor will be announced, since Israel has made it clear that whoever emerges will also be an "unequivocal target".The only person speaking often and openly about this highly sensitive choice is Trump, who has remarked: "Most of the people we had in mind are dead." You read more of BBC chief international correspondent Lyse Doucet's analysis here Image source, AFP via Getty ImagesWe can bring you some developing news now on what appears to be a large attack on one of Tehran's main commercial airports. Burning planes and large plumes of smoke are visible at the Mehrabad airport - Iran's busiest airport and main domestic hub - in footage shared by eyewitnesses on social media. Satellite imagery taken on Friday shows multiple aircraft were at the airport.Iranian state media is also reporting some parts of the airport have been targeted. It comes after the Israeli military said it was launching a "broad-scale new wave of strikes" in the country. It previously targeted the airport on 4 March, saying its strikes dismantled defence and detection systems that were a threat to the Israeli Air Force, which included the helicopter manufacturing section of the airport.It is not yet clear which parts of the airport has been bombed in the fresh attack but witnesses say tonight's bombardment has been much more intense.Image source, AFP via Getty Images Saudi Arabia has intercepted six drones on their way to an oil field and a ballistic missile headed to an air base, the country's Ministry of Defence spokesperson says on X.The drones were intercepted in the Empty Quarter, a vast desert in the south of the country. It is home to rich oil reserves including the Shaybah oil field which the Ministry of Defence says was the target of the attack.The site produces a million barrels of oil a day, according to Saudi Arabian oil company Aramco.The ballistic missile was on its way to the Prince Sultan Air Base, it added. title: Walkot Medan Rico Waas: Idul Fitri Waktu yang Tepat Lakukan Refleksi dan Otokritik
summary: Wali Kota Medan, Rico Tri Putra Bayu Waas, memaknai Idul Fitri sebagai momen refleksi dan otokritik atas upaya pembangunan kota Medan, termasuk bencana banjir yang dialami. Menurutnya, peristiwa banjir adalah pengingat untuk lebih memperhatikan lingkungan dan memperkuat infrastruktur agar masyarakat lebih berdaya. Rico Waas juga mengajak masyarakat untuk menjadikan Idul Fitri sebagai momentum memperkuat persatuan dan kebersamaan dalam membangun kota dengan semangat "Medan untuk Semua".
originalContent: MEDAN, KOMPAS.com - Wali Kota (Walkot) Medan, Rico Tri Putra Bayu Waas, memaknai perayaan Idul Fitri sebagai momen yang tepat untuk merefleksikan dan melakukan otokritik atas berbagai upaya yang telah diperbuat dalam membangun Medan, termasuk juga bencana banjir yang dialami. "Idul Fitri sebagai waktu yang tepat untuk melakukan refleksi dan otokritik, khususnya dalam upaya pembangunan kota," kata Rico Waas kepada awak media usai pelaksanaan Shalat Idul Fitri (Id) 1447 Hijriah di Lapangan Merdeka Medan, Sabtu (21/3/2026). Dia menjelaskan, peristiwa banjir yang sempat melanda sejumlah wilayah di Medan, adalah pengingat bagi semua pihak. “Kita baru saja melewati bencana. Ini pengingat untuk lebih memperhatikan lingkungan. Pembangunan infrastruktur harus diperkuat agar masyarakat lebih berdaya dan kota kita semakin tangguh ke depan,” ujar Rico Waas. Baca juga: Bobby Nasution Bagikan 2.500 Paket Sembako dari Presiden Prabowo di Medan Oleh karena itu, menurut dia, pembangunan yang dilakukan harus berorientasi pada kepentingan masyarakat luas, bukan kepentingan pribadi atau kelompok tertentu. Dengan begitu maka hasil pembangunan benar-benar dapat dirasakan seluruh warga. Dia pun mengajak agar menjadikan Idul Fitri atau Lebaran sebagai momentum untuk memperkuat persatuan dan kebersamaan dalam membangun kota. Dengan semangat "Medan untuk Semua", Rico Waas menekankan pentingnya kolaborasi dalam membangun kota Rico menyadari bahwa Medan kota majemuk, membutuhkan pendekatan yang tidak sederhana dalam menyatukan berbagai elemen masyarakat. Sehingga, memerlukan komunikasi berkelanjutan dan pendekatan yang tepat kepada setiap kelompok. “Semua elemen harus dirangkul satu per satu dengan cara komunikasi yang berbeda-beda. Jadi tidak bisa sekali jalan langsung selesai. Ini butuh proses terus-menerus,” katanya. title: Desak-desakan, Ribuan Warga Antre Dapatkan Sembako dari Bobby Nasution
summary: Ribuan warga Kota Medan berdesak-desakan saat antre untuk mendapatkan bantuan sambako dari Gubernur Sumatera Utara, Bobby Nasution di Rumah Dinas di Jalan Sudirman, Medan, Sabtu (21/3/2026). Warga telah mengantre sejak pukul 09.00 WIB dan baru dapat sembako pada pukul 13.00 WIB. Gubernur Bobby Nasution menyediakan 3.000 lebih paket sembako untuk warga di Kota Medan, yang telah habis.
originalContent: MEDAN, KOMPAS.com - Ribuan warga Kota Medan berdesak-desakan saat antre untuk mendapatkan bantuan sambako dari Gubernur Sumatera Utara, Bobby Nasution di Rumah Dinas di Jalan Sudirman, Medan, Sabtu (21/3/2026). Pantauan di lokasi, hingga pukul 13.10 WIB, warga masih memadati pintu masuk rumah dinas Gubernur Sumatera Utara (Sumut). Warga diketahui, sudah mengantre sejak pukul 09.00 WIB di depan rumah dinas tersebut. Salah satu penerima paket sembako, Bety (48), mengungkapkan sudah masuk antrian sejak pagi dan baru dapat sembako pada pukul 13.00 WIB. "Jam 9 pagi nunggu, baru dapat giliran jam 12 siang," kata Bety, yang mengaku kelelahan setelah berdiri berjam-jam, Sabtu. Baca juga: Bobby Nasution Bagikan 2.500 Paket Sembako dari Presiden Prabowo di Medan Namun demikian, Bety mengaku senang karena akhirnya memperoleh bantuan sembako dari Gubernur Sumut. "Syukurlah, lega setelah antrian lama dan panjang sekali," ujar Bety, sembari menunggu rekannya yang masih ikut antrean. Dia juga mengucapkan terima kasih kepada Bobby Nasution yang memberikan bantuan sembako di momen Lebaran. Bety kemudian menunjukkan jenis sembako yang diterimanya, berisi minyak goreng, bubuk teh, mi instan, gula hingga sarden. Gubernur Bobby Nasution menyediakan 3.000 lebih paket sembako untuk warga di Kota Medan dan semuanya sudah habis. Pada saat pembagian, petugas dari Satop PP, Badan Penanggulangan Bencana Daerah (BPBD) hingga Dinas Perhubungan dikerahkan agar proses pembagian paket sembako berjalan lancar. title: Derita Luka Parah, Wanita yang Ditabrak Personel Polda Sumut Meninggal Dunia
summary: Derita Luka Parah, Wanita yang Ditabrak Personel Polda Sumut Meninggal Dunia. com - Elida Delviana Tamin meninggal dunia usai menjalani pengobatan karena mengalami kecelakaan di HW Tiger Club Medan, Jalan Merak Jingga, Kota Medan, Sumatera Utara.  Wanita berusia 26 tahun ini menghembuskan nafas terakhirnya saat terbaring di kediaman abangnya, di Jalan Pendidikan, Kecamatan Percut Sei Tuan, Kabupaten Deli Serdang pada Rabu (13/5/2026).
originalContent: MEDAN, KOMPAS.com - Elida Delviana Tamin meninggal dunia usai menjalani pengobatan karena mengalami kecelakaan di HW Tiger Club Medan, Jalan Merak Jingga, Kota Medan, Sumatera Utara. Wanita berusia 26 tahun ini menghembuskan nafas terakhirnya saat terbaring di kediaman abangnya, di Jalan Pendidikan, Kecamatan Percut Sei Tuan, Kabupaten Deli Serdang pada Rabu (13/5/2026). Yogie (29), selaku abang kandungnya, mengungkapkan kala itu keluarga, kerabat, serta temannya sedang datang untuk merayakan ulangtahun anaknya sekaligus menjenguk Elida. "Terus jam 9 malam bubarlah. Pergilah aku keluar beli rokok. Tak lama ditelepon istri suruh pulang," kata Yogi saat dihubungi Kompas.com melalui saluran telepon pada Jumat (15/5/2026). Baca juga: Jumiatun Meninggal, Korban Kecelakaan Bus ALS di Muratara Bertambah Jadi 19 Orang Setibanya di rumah, Yogi kaget melihat Elida muntah lalu lekas keluar untuk memanggil dokter dari klinik terdekat. Namun, ketika kembali, air matanya tumpah melihat Elida telah tiada. Yogi amat terpukul. Besok harinya, jenazah Elida dimakamkan tak jauh dari kediamannya. Elida adalah adik perempuan satu-satunya, yang sangat peduli ke dirinya dan adiknya yang lain. "Dia anak kedua dari empat bersaudara. Dia itu baik sekali. Memang putus kuliah. Tapi dia yang bantu adik untuk kuliah, sampai membelikan motor," ucap Yogie. "Dia kerja freelance kayak konten kreator gitu, promosikan produk-produk. Setiap lebaran kami empat pasti kumpul, karena mama di Malaysia. Dia paling heboh dan peduli sama kami semua," katanya. Baca juga: Kecelakaan di Tanjakan Selarong Puncak Bogor, Pikap Tabrak 2 Motor hingga Satu Orang Luka Berat Derita Elida Akibat Kecelakaan Yogie mengungkapkan, adik perempuannya itu menderita luka sangat parah usai ditabrak mobil yang dikendarai personel Polda Sumut pada Minggu (26/10/2026). Elida dilarikan ke Rumah Sakit Columbia dan menjalani pertobatan selama sebulan. Lalu, dia dipindahkan lagi ke Rumah Sakit Bhayangkara Medan, dan dirawat sebulan pula. "Tulang rusuk kanan patah tujuh yang kiri parah dua. Terus patahan tulang rusuk di kanan menusuk paru-parunya," ucap Yogie. "Terus pembuluh darah di kepala pecah, terus saraf otak kanan dan kirinya rusak. Makanya, saya tak bisa komunikasi dengan dia. Matanya terbuka aja. Tapi gak bisa ngomong," katanya. Baca juga: Cegah Kecelakaan Truk, Pemkot Semarang Bakal Bangun Pos Pantau Permanen di Silayur Elida mulai dirawat jalan di kediaman Yogie sejak Januari 2026, dengan syarat dua minggu sekali kontrol di Rumah Sakit Bhayangkara namun berujung meninggal dunia. "Kalau soal sama polisi kemarin sudah damai. Biaya pertobatan semua ditanggung," sebut Yogie. Sebelumnya diberitakan, tiga personel Polda Sumut, Bripda VP, Bripda ST, dan Bripda BI diproses hukum usai terlibat kecelakaan yang menimpa Elida.

title: Sempat Tertahan 2 Hari di Rumah Sakit karena Biaya, Kakek 84 Tahun Meninggal Dunia di Griya Lansia
summary: Sempat Tertahan 2 Hari di Rumah Sakit karena Biaya, Kakek 84 Tahun Meninggal Dunia di Griya Lansia. com - Harun Nurdin Lubis (84), lansia yang sebelumnya disebut sempat tertahan selama dua hari di RSUD Amri Tambunan karena belum memiliki biaya pengobatan, meninggal dunia.  Kakek yang akrab disapa Opung Lubis itu meninggal dunia pada Kamis (14/5/2026) sekitar pukul 15.
originalContent: DELI SERDANG, KOMPAS.com - Harun Nurdin Lubis (84), lansia yang sebelumnya disebut sempat tertahan selama dua hari di RSUD Amri Tambunan karena belum memiliki biaya pengobatan, meninggal dunia. Kakek yang akrab disapa Opung Lubis itu meninggal dunia pada Kamis (14/5/2026) sekitar pukul 15.00 WIB di Rumah Lansia Bahagia, Desa Tanjung Baru, Kecamatan Tanjung Morawa, Kabupaten Deli Serdang, Sumatera Utara. Jenazah Harun Nurdin Lubis dimakamkan pada Jumat (15/5/2026) pagi. Baca juga: Gedung Pelayanan Jantung Terbakar, RSUD dr Soetomo Sebut Hydrant Menyala tapi Tekanan Kurang Meninggal sehari setelah pulang dari rumah sakit Berdasarkan informasi yang dihimpun dari Tribun Medan, Harun Nurdin Lubis meninggal dunia sehari setelah pulang dari RSUD Amri Tambunan. Pihak Yayasan Rumah Lansia Bahagia menyebut, Harun baru bisa dibawa pulang pada Rabu (13/5/2026) pagi setelah donasi untuk membayar biaya pengobatan terkumpul. Biaya pengobatan Harun sebesar Rp 3,4 juta disebut telah diketahui pihak yayasan sejak 11 Mei 2026. Saat itu, Harun sudah diperbolehkan pulang dari rumah sakit, tetapi belum bisa dibawa karena biaya pengobatan belum tersedia. Yayasan sampaikan kabar duka Kabar meninggalnya Harun Nurdin Lubis disampaikan Ketua Yayasan Rumah Lansia Bahagia, Alika, melalui unggahan Instagram Story di akun alika26. Dalam unggahan tersebut, Alika menyampaikan bahwa pihak yayasan merasa sangat kehilangan sosok Harun. Alika juga menyebut Harun sebagai sosok yang dekat dengan sesama lansia di Rumah Lansia Bahagia. "Innalillahi wa innalillahi rojiun telah meninggal dunia Opung Nurdin Lubis atau yang lebih dikenal dengan Opung Harun Lubis. Siang ini jam 3 sore, setelah sebelumnya Opung mendapatkan perawatan intensif di Rumah Sakit dari tanggal 6 Mei lalu," tulis Story Instagram alika26 pada Kamis (14/5/2026). Alika juga menyebut, permintaan terakhir Harun sebelum meninggal adalah dibelikan kelereng. Pixabay Ilustrasi rumah sakit. Yayuk Setiawati (49), seorang warga Desa Sidomulyo, Kecamatan Gondang, resmi melaporkan Rumah Sakit (RS) Era Medika dan dokter spesialis bedah berinisial dr IGPS ke Polres Tulungagung, Rabu (29/4/2026). Laporan tersebut dipicu oleh dugaan malapraktik berupa tertinggalnya benda asing berupa kain kasa di dalam luka bekas operasi pengangkatan tumor jinak yang dijalani Yayuk di rumah sakit tersebut. Pihak RSUD sebut pasien sudah pulang sejak 11 Mei Sebelumnya, pihak RSUD Amri Tambunan beberapa kali menyampaikan bahwa Harun Nurdin Lubis pulang dari rumah sakit pada 11 Mei 2026. Melalui Humas RSUD Amri Tambunan, dr Devi Sagala membantah keterangan pihak yayasan yang menyebut Harun baru pulang pada 13 Mei 2026. Devi menyebut tidak benar apabila pihak yayasan menyatakan Harun pulang pada 13 Mei.

title: Sopir Angkot di Medan Berkomplot Rampok Penumpang, Pura-pura Diancam Parang
summary: Sopir Angkot di Medan Berkomplot Rampok Penumpang, Pura-pura Diancam Parang. com - Polisi mengungkap skenario perampokan terhadap penumpang Angkot Morina 81 yang terjadi di Medan, Sumatera Utara, pada Selasa (7/4/2026).  Dua pelaku ditangkap, yakni Erikson Napitupulu (44), warga Jalan P Ternate, Kelurahan Belawan Bahari, Kecamatan Medan Belawan, dan Sony Liston Siringgo-ringgo (35), warga Dusun IV Timur.
originalContent: MEDAN, KOMPAS.com - Polisi mengungkap skenario perampokan terhadap penumpang Angkot Morina 81 yang terjadi di Medan, Sumatera Utara, pada Selasa (7/4/2026). Dua pelaku ditangkap, yakni Erikson Napitupulu (44), warga Jalan P Ternate, Kelurahan Belawan Bahari, Kecamatan Medan Belawan, dan Sony Liston Siringgo-ringgo (35), warga Dusun IV Timur. Dalam kasus ini, Erikson berperan sebagai sopir angkot, sedangkan Sony menjadi eksekutor yang menodong penumpang dengan senjata tajam. Baca juga: Nenek 60 Tahun di Pekanbaru Dibunuh Perampok: Emas hingga Dollar Raib, Eks Menantu Diduga Terlibat Dua pelaku ditangkap di lokasi berbeda Kabid Humas Polda Sumatera Utara Kombes Ferry Walintukan mengatakan, Erikson ditangkap pada Sabtu (25/4/2026) di Desa Siboro, Kecamatan Sianjur Mula-mula, Kabupaten Samosir. Sementara itu, Sony ditangkap pada 30 April 2026 di sebuah perkebunan di Dusun Muara Kilis, Desa Lubuk Madarsyah, Kecamatan Tengah Ilir, Kabupaten Tebo, Jambi. Ferry mengatakan, kedua pelaku sebelumnya berpura-pura tidak saling mengenal. Namun, hasil penyelidikan polisi menunjukkan Erikson dan Sony merupakan komplotan yang sudah merencanakan perampokan terhadap penumpang angkot. Awal mula skenario perampokan Perencanaan bermula pada Selasa (7/4/2026) sekitar pukul 09.00 WIB. Saat itu, Erikson bertemu Sony di pangkalan Angkot Morina 81. Sony kemudian bercerita kepada Erikson bahwa dirinya ingin merantau ke Jambi, tetapi tidak memiliki uang. Dari pembicaraan itu, Sony mengajak Erikson bekerja sama merampok penumpang angkot. Keduanya menyepakati peran masing-masing, yakni Erikson sebagai sopir dan Sony sebagai eksekutor. Hasil perampokan rencananya akan dibagi dua. Pelaku berpura-pura tidak saling kenal Sekitar pukul 10.00 WIB, kedua pelaku mulai menjalankan rencana dari pangkalan angkot. Erikson berada di kursi sopir, sedangkan Sony awalnya duduk di sampingnya. Saat angkot melintas di Jalan Yos Sudarso, Sony berpindah ke bagian belakang penumpang sambil menyembunyikan senjata tajam. Di persimpangan Sungai Mati, seorang penumpang perempuan naik ke angkot. Penumpang perempuan lain kemudian menyusul naik, disusul seorang laki-laki berusia lanjut. Tidak lama kemudian, seorang perempuan dan seorang laki-laki naik bersamaan.

title: 2 Tahun Buron, Calo Kasus Korupsi KUR Rp 6,2 M Ditangkap di Pontianak
summary: 2 Tahun Buron, Calo Kasus Korupsi KUR Rp 6,2 M Ditangkap di Pontianak. com - Setelah dua tahun menjadi buron, Habib Mahendra ditangkap Kejari Medan.  Habib diduga terlibat kasus dugaan korupsi pemberian kredit usaha rakyat (KUR) bank BUMN.
originalContent: MEDAN, KOMPAS.com - Setelah dua tahun menjadi buron, Habib Mahendra ditangkap Kejari Medan. Habib diduga terlibat kasus dugaan korupsi pemberian kredit usaha rakyat (KUR) bank BUMN. “Dia ditangkap 13 Mei malam di Pontianak,” kata Kepala Seksi Intelijen Kejari Medan, Valentino Harry Parluhutan Manurung, dalam keterangan resmi yang diterima Kompas.com pada Jumat (15/5/2026). Baca juga: Korupsi KUR Bank Daerah di Sumsel Rp 3,9 Miliar: Dua Tersangka Ditahan, Satu Pergi Haji Valentino menyampaikan, perkara tersebut bermula dari dugaan tindak pidana korupsi pemberian kredit yang tidak sesuai ketentuan pada periode 2021 hingga Mei 2024. "Terpidana Habib Mahendra berperan sebagai narahubung atau calo untuk mencari orang yang bersedia memberikan data pribadinya sebagai nasabah penerima kredit KUR," ujar Valentino. Menurut dia, data-data tersebut kemudian digunakan sebagai nasabah penerima kredit KUR yang dananya dipakai oleh M Juned selaku kepala unit bank periode April 2021-April 2023, Erwin Handoko selaku kepala unit periode April 2023-Mei 2024, dan David Sloan selaku mantan mantri. "Akibat perbuatan tersebut, negara mengalami kerugian sebesar Rp 6,28 miliar," ucap Valentino. Sementara itu, Kepala Seksi Tindak Pidana Khusus Kejari Medan Juanda Ronny mengatakan, pihaknya telah menetapkan Habib sebagai tersangka berdasarkan Surat Penetapan Tersangka Nomor TAP-08/L.2.10/Fd.2/11/2024 pada 5 November 2024. Baca juga: Korupsi KUR BTN Rp 13,9 M: Eks Kacab BSD Divonis 1 Tahun Penjara, Anak Buahnya 6 Tahun, Satu Terdakwa Bebas Namun, tersangka disebut tidak kooperatif karena tidak pernah memenuhi panggilan penyidik sehingga ditetapkan sebagai DPO melalui Surat Penetapan Daftar Pencarian Orang Nomor PRINT-197/L.2.10/Fd.2/01/2025 pada 16 Januari 2025. Perkara tersebut kemudian disidangkan secara in absentia di Pengadilan Tipikor pada Pengadilan Negeri Medan dan diputus pada 23 Juni 2025. "Dalam putusannya, majelis hakim menjatuhkan pidana penjara selama enam tahun serta denda Rp300 juta subsider lima bulan kurungan kepada Habib," ujar Juanda. Setelah ditangkap, Habib dibawa ke Rutan Tanjung Gusta Medan. Selanjutnya, Habib akan menjalani persidangan di Pengadilan Negeri Medan. "Kemudian, terpidana akan dieksekusi ke Rutan Tanjung Gusta Medan untuk menjalani hukuman berdasarkan putusan pengadilan," ucap dia.
